title: rcf-schemas 0.9.0 consumer side C: the expectBody.matches canary rule
summary: rcf-lite carries the rcf-schemas 0.9.0 expectBody.matches canary rule (US-19401): a pattern that matches both canaries, or does not compile, fails deterministic verify. Delivers AC-19401-13 to AC-19401-17.
approach: In src/verify/engine/deterministic.js, before the body test, compile expectBody.matches in a guard and test it against the fixed canaries qzvxjk0729 and ~!@#%^&*(); matching both, or failing to compile, resolves fail with failedExpectation expectBody.matches and the named reason.
notes: Order in the train: after FBS-228 (dependsOnFbsIds FBS-228, buildOrder 232). Split from the original FBS-227 by ledger 52 into three chained specs. Tests: this spec's share of TS-260 is TC-260-specific-pattern-passes, TC-260-vacuous-pattern-fails, TC-260-non-compiling-pattern-fails, TC-260-match-anything-never-passes and TC-260-one-canary-and-header-substring, declared in test/verify/expect-body-canary.test.js; the test-author turns each into a red test at this FBS's own Define fill round. Commits carry Hand: trailers. No freeze, no ack verbs.
